title: Per-pixel feature vector 26 -> 30 (4 Z3 transferable invariants)
why: Test whether 4 more per-pixel features improve in-domain LOCO and OOD transfer accuracy
hypothesis: Adding inv_clip_frac/inv_laplacian_var/inv_hist_entropy/inv_dct_hf_lf raises OOD transfer at little in-domain cost
data: 150 IndEgo gold (LOCO) + 160 Egocentric-10K OOD (grouped CI) + 108 round-3 hold-out (scored once); human labels
regime: in-domain LOCO + OOD zero-shot adapted z-score
method: LOCO logistic C=0.3 balanced; per-domain z-score, IndEgo sign, equal-weight mean; factory-grouped bootstrap; per-feature ablation

title: F30 cost: ms/window of the 4 added invariants
why: Quantify the extraction cost of the new features
hypothesis: The 4 invariants add <30% over the 26-feature cost

summary: In-domain LOCO 26->30: 0.8100->0.8118 (+0.0018 ns). OOD adapted z-score full vector 0.3864->0.4954 (+0.109, paired grouped CI [0.027,0.199], 99.4%>0); hold-out 108 0.3580->0.3995. Frozen logistic unchanged. The 4 per-pixel invariants alone score OOD 0.793 / hold-out 0.692, matching the curated 14-feature baseline (0.781/0.676). Cost +57 ms/window (+25%).
decision: Keep the 4 invariants in the per-pixel extractor (free in-domain, large adapted-OOD gain); do not claim it beats the frozen ensemble.

summary: Decode 637 ms, 26 feats 229 ms, added 4 = 57.4 ms/window (25.1%), 30 total 284 ms (median, 16 windows).
